title: Your possible world
description: 这个世界由当前布局中的 3 个 unit 生成，覆盖 1 个高度层，最高达到 Z=0.0。水、火、土先生成自然地形基底：土 1、水 1。动物和人作为高阶生命元素，只在自然基底上形成较小范围的生态痕迹或文明改造：人 1。实体结构主要停留在低层，地貌更接近底面分布。主要区域关系为：central region 的自然基底为 空/未塑形，生命覆盖为 人，形成 very small life-marked area with no broad natural terrain base; limited human modifications such as paths, huts, workshops, farms, walls, or ruins；central region 的自然基底为 土，生命覆盖为 无，形成 earth-shaped ground, hills, rock, grassland, or mountain ridges；central region 的自然基底为 水，生命覆盖为 无，形成 water-shaped basins, rivers, lakes, or wetlands。综合地貌特征包括：very small life-marked area with no broad natural terrain base; limited human modifications such as paths, huts, workshops, farms, walls, or ruins、earth-shaped ground, hills, rock, grassland, or mountain ridges、water-shaped basins, rivers, lakes, or wetlands。

terrainGrammar.base_description: Earth dominates the bottom layer, so the base world is land. Small water becomes lakes, ponds, rivers, or wetlands. Small fire becomes scorched land, volcanic cracks, or burnt areas.
terrain_features: 1 water unit(s) read as lakes, ponds, rivers, or wetlands inside land
human_outcomes: human (1.32,1.31,0.0): habitable edge (plains, grassland, hills, or riverbank edge); show sparse settlement, paths, bridge, camp, farm edge, port, or hot-spring shelter
